A antena de alto ganho do módulo de serv: The Apollo service module's high-gain antenna could be pointed by hand with two controls, one for pitch and one for yaw, while the crew watched the signal strength. On Apollo 11, Houston even asked for manual mode and read the angles over the radio.
A antena de alto ganho perdeu a Terra e:
The high-gain antenna lost Earth and Houston only receives static. Its beam is narrow: it must point almost exactly at Earth.

[b]Goal:[/b] find the direction of the strongest signal and hold the antenna there until it locks.
[b]How to play:[/b] move the antenna with WASD or the ARROWS, or hold the click on the display. The meter shows whether the signal is rising or falling.
[b]Careful:[/b] time is short and, on higher difficulties, the spacecraft keeps rotating.
A antena de alto ganho perdeu o alinhame: The high-gain antenna lost its alignment with Earth. Houston only receives static, and reentry is getting closer.
A antena de alto ganho só funciona apont: The high-gain antenna only works when pointed at Earth.

A bolsa de bebida precisa ser enchida no:
The drink bag must be filled at the dispenser before drinking. Without gravity, the bag does not stay still and any water that escapes turns into droplets floating around the cabin.

[b]Goal:[/b] fill the bag up to the green band.
[b]How to play:[/b] bring the nozzle to the bag's valve with the mouse or the ARROWS. Hold the click or SPACE to fill and release inside the green band.
[b]Careful:[/b] filling with the nozzle off the valve wastes water, and going past the band makes the bag leak.

A queima do motor e o acoplamento soltar:
The engine burn and the docking knocked objects loose around the cabin. In microgravity nothing falls: everything floats until it hits something.

[b]Goal:[/b] secure each object to the velcro of the same color before time runs out.
[b]How to play:[/b] click the object, drag it to the velcro and release.
[b]Careful:[/b] every object that hits the switch panel counts as a hit.
A refeição acabou, mas as embalagens vaz:
The meal is over, but the empty packages cannot float around: food leftovers spoil and foul the cabin air.

[b]Goal:[/b] stow every package in the trash bag.
[b]How to play:[/b] drag each package into a free space in the bag. You can take out a stowed package and move it.
[b]Careful:[/b] space is limited. If time runs out with packages left out, the bag will not close.

Nas naves Apollo, cada item solto tinha: On Apollo spacecraft, every loose item had a marked place and a way to stay put without gravity: velcro, clips, straps or bungee cords. A forgotten object can float behind a panel or flip a switch.

• Apertar antes da hora não gasta a tent: • Pressing too early does not use up the attempt.

• Cerca de 3 dias e 4 horas após o lança:
• About 3 days and 4 hours after launch, the insertion burn put the spacecraft in lunar orbit.
• For almost a day, the crew checked the systems and prepared the lunar module.
• On Apollo 11, Armstrong and Aldrin moved into the lunar module [i]Eagle[/i] and Collins stayed in [i]Columbia[/i]. In APOLLO6, Thomas Walker flies the descent.
• After confirmation, [i]Eagle[/i] undocks and begins the final powered descent.
• O mapa mostra a área de pouso no centr: • The map shows the landing area in the center, the module as a triangle and the drift arrow. Forward is up.
• Quando a cápsula cruzar 3.050 m, apare: • When the capsule crosses 3,050 m, SPACE · DEPLOY PARACHUTES appears.
• Quase 12 horas de voo comprimidas: a n:
• Almost 12 hours of flight compressed: the spacecraft gets close to Earth.
• The service module will be separated and left behind.
• [i]Columbia[/i], with the three astronauts, will make the reentry and splashdown in the Pacific Ocean on its own.
• When the main parachutes deploy, you will perform the manual contingency deployment created for the game.
• Segure ESPAÇO para acelerar o motor ao: • Hold SPACE to throttle the engine up gradually. Release it and the engine loses power gradually until it shuts off. About 48% balances lunar gravity.
• Soltando WASD, o módulo volta a ficar: • Releasing WASD levels the module again, but the drift continues until you correct it.
• Superfície: a tripulação passou cerca:
• Surface: the crew spent about 21 h 36 min on the Moon, went out on an extravehicular activity, collected samples and deployed the instruments. Science data recorded: [b]%s[/b].
• Liftoff: [i]Eagle[/i]'s ascent stage left the Moon. The lunar module's descent stage stayed on the surface.
• Rendezvous: [i]Eagle[/i] docked with [i]Columbia[/i]. Crew and samples moved into the command module and the ascent stage was jettisoned.
• Departure: about 5 days and 15 hours after launch, the service module engine put [i]Columbia[/i] on the path back to Earth.
• Toque o solo devagar, sem deslizar e n: • Touch down slowly, without drifting and level. Green = safe, yellow = caution, red = danger.
• Você tem 2 segundos para apertar ESPAÇ: • You have 2 seconds to press SPACE.
• W e S inclinam para frente e para trás: • W and S tilt forward and back. A and D tilt left and right. The engine pushes toward the tilted side.
